data.name: Armin
data.gender_notes: Armin is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Armin is a Germanic name derived from the Old High German word ‘ermen’, which means ‘strong’ or ‘soldier’. The name became popular in Europe during the Middle Ages and was often given to boys born into noble families. In the Christian tradition, Armin is associated with the virtue of courage and loyalty. The name Armin carries the meaning “Soldier, strong man” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Armin usually hope their child will grow to embody soldier, strong man and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Armin belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Soldier, strong man.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Armin total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_greek.name: Άρμιν
in_greek.meaning: Ο Άρμιν σημαίνει φύλακας ή προασπιστής
in_greek.long_meaning: Ο Άρμιν είναι ένα όνομα που προέρχεται από την ελληνική γλώσσα και σημαίνει φύλακας ή προασπιστής. Το όνομα Άρμιν έχει σχέση με τη λέξη 'Άρμ' που σημαίνει να φυλάσσω ή να προστατεύω. Στην πρώιμη Εκκλησία, το όνομα Άρμιν είχε χρησιμοποιηθεί ως σύμβολο προστασίας και φροντίδας. Σήμερα, το όνομα Άρμιν διατηρεί τη σημασία του ως ένα όνομα που αντιπροσωπεύει τη δύναμη και τη σταθερότητα.

data.cultural_impact: The name Armin has a rich cultural history, having been borne by notable figures such as Arminius, a German hero who defeated the Romans in the Teutoburg Forest in 9 AD. This victory is celebrated in German folklore and has been a source of national pride. Arminius' victory signified the resistance and survival of the Germanic people against Roman occupation, making Armin a name synonymous with strength, resilience, and bravery.
data.spiritual_significance: In a spiritual context, the name Armin carries the deeper meaning of being a warrior for Christ. Armin represents the brave soul who is not only strong in physical strength but also has the inner fortitude to resist temptation and stay true to their spiritual journey.
